summary: Enhance your expertise with our Valuation for Financial Reporting Standards Training Course. Gain essential skills to navigate complex financial landscapes.
lede: Financial reporting valuation measures the fair value of assets and liabilities for financial statements. For finance and accounting professionals who prepare, review or audit these estimates, the course covers deriving discount rates, valuing intangible assets with methods such as relief from royalty and MPEEM, allocating purchase prices in business combinations, and testing goodwill and assets for impairment.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for finance and accounting professionals responsible for measuring, reviewing, or auditing fair value estimates.
modules: Cost of Capital and Discount Rate Derivation
Business Combinations and Purchase Price Allocation
Impairment Testing for Goodwill and Assets
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial accounting principles (IFRS or US GAAP) and intermediate Excel skills are required. No advanced coding or programming experience is necessary.
